product_metadata.title: Mohawk Home Symphony Amicalola Woven Rug, 2'1x7'10, Saddle
features: Area rugs should be spot cleaned with a solution of mild detergent and water or cleaned professionally. Regular vacuuming helps rugs remain attractive and serviceable.
Machine Woven; Cut Pile; 100% Polyester (EverStrand PET); EverStrand; Latex
description: Featuring stunning and refined traditional and transitional designs, our Symphony Collection is the peak of excellence. This new line of rugs features one of the brand’s top performance fibers, Ever Strand. This recoiled polyester fiber combines superior durability with ultimate softness, because the manufacturing process utilizes the highest-grade plastic from recycled beverage bottles. Ever Strand includes up to 100% recycled content and offer inherent stain- free beauty at an affordable price.

details.Product Care Instructions: Taking proper care of your rug will prolong its life and appearance. Vacuum your rug regularly to remove loose soil, taking special care when vacuuming fringe and edges. Some throw rugs, especially for bathrooms, can be washed in your home washing machine. Always comply with the manufacturer’s recommended cleaning methods on the attached label to prevent warranty invalidation and damage to your rug. Have a professional deep clean your rug as needed. Several cleaning methods will work, but to prevent rapid resoiling of your rug, it is important to completely remove any residual cleaning agents.
